name: e2e-blank-slate-journey-r2
description: Round-2 end-to-end blank-slate journey (2026-07-25): a new SG buyer on a CUSTOM starter plan (tpl-hdb-4room) drives intake (bare BTO) -> theme furnish -> BSJ-8 floor levels (2D FFL pills + real 3D lowered floor/riser) -> MEP/circuits -> BSJ-2 aircon planner + 3D trunking route -> DaylightPanel 'Trunking ~XX m' -> reno budget aircon-trunking line -> score/checks/handover -> drawing set (RCP dashed trunking) + tiler/aircon/electrician trade packs. Print docs are captured into window vars and rendered last (document.write destroys the app). Run with SHOT_GPU=1.

steps.name: dismiss-overlays
steps.eval: (() => { try { localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded','1') } catch {} const s = window.__store.getState(); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.(); s.setManualHour?.(13); s.setUiMode?.('simple'); s.reresolveFeatureFlags?.(); })()

steps.name: assert-four-intake-states
steps.eval: (() => { const t = document.body.textContent || ''; for (const n of ['New BTO — bare', 'New BTO — with OCS', 'Resale — as handed over', 'Resale — after strip-out']) { if (!t.includes(n)) throw new Error('intake state missing from wizard: ' + n); } return 'all-4-present'; })()

steps.name: assert-bare-seeding
steps.eval: (() => { const s = window.__store.getState(); const room = (id) => s.floorPlan.rooms.find(r => r.id === id); if (room('h4-bed2').floor !== 'floor-screed') throw new Error('bed2 not screed: ' + room('h4-bed2').floor); if (room('h4-kit').floor !== 'floor-tile-grey') throw new Error('kitchen floor changed: ' + room('h4-kit').floor); if ((s.doors['h4-master']||{}).leaf !== 'none') throw new Error('master door leaf not absent'); if (!s.baselinePlan) throw new Error('no demolition baseline captured'); return 'bare-ok'; })()

steps.name: furnish-theme
steps.eval: (() => { const s = window.__store.getState(); s.applyLayoutPreset('japandi'); return String(s.items.length); })()

waitFor.store: state.featureFlags.switchCircuits === true && state.featureFlags.airconSystem === true && state.featureFlags.airconTrunking === true && state.featureFlags.floorLevels === true

steps.name: set-floor-levels
steps.eval: (() => { const s = window.__store.getState(); s.updateRoom('h4-mbath', { floorLevelMm: -50 }); s.updateRoom('h4-cbath', { floorLevelMm: -30 }); })()

steps.name: assert-offsets-module
steps.eval: (async () => { const m = await import('/src/floorplan/floorLevels3d.ts'); const s = window.__store.getState(); const off = m.floorOffsetAtPoint(s.floorPlan, 4.5, 8.8, true); if (Math.abs(off - (-0.05)) > 1e-6) throw new Error('mbath 3D offset wrong: ' + off); window.__risers = m.buildThresholdRisers ? 'module-ok' : 'no-fn'; })()

steps.name: assert-trunking-routes
steps.eval: (async () => { const sys = await import('/src/analysis/airconSystem.ts'); const trk = await import('/src/analysis/airconTrunking.ts'); const s = window.__store.getState(); const plan = sys.buildAirconSystemPlan(s.floorPlan, s.orientationDeg); const input = trk.resolveAirconTrunkingInput(s.floorPlan, plan, s.items); const built = trk.buildAirconTrunkingPlan(s.floorPlan, plan, input); const resolved = built.runs.filter(r => r.resolved); if (resolved.length === 0) throw new Error('no trunking route resolved on custom plan'); window.__trunk = { resolved: resolved.length, total: built.totalLengthM }; })()

steps.name: trunking-readout
steps.failMessage: DaylightPanel never showed the 'Trunking ~XX m' readout

steps.name: assert-trunking-budget-line
steps.eval: (() => { const t = document.querySelector('.panel.mini.aux')?.textContent || ''; if (!/trunking/i.test(t)) throw new Error('budget has no aircon-trunking line'); if (!/waterproof/i.test(t)) throw new Error('budget lost the waterproofing line'); if (/NaN/.test(t)) throw new Error('NaN in budget'); const m = t.match(/trunking[^$]*?([\d.]+)\s*lin\.m/i); if (m && window.__trunk && Math.abs(parseFloat(m[1]) - window.__trunk.total) > 1) throw new Error('budget trunking length ' + m[1] + ' != modeled ' + window.__trunk.total); return 'budget-ok'; })()

steps.name: open-checks
steps.eval: (() => { const s = window.__store.getState(); s.setClearancePanelOpen(true); if (!s.clearanceOn) s.toggleClearance(); })()

steps.name: intercept-window-open
steps.eval: window.open = () => ({ document: { write(h) { window.__lastHtml = h }, close() {} }, close() {}, focus() {}, print() {} })

steps.name: capture-drawing-set
steps.eval: (async () => { const { openDrawingSet } = await import('/src/ui/openDrawingSet.ts'); window.__lastHtml = null; await openDrawingSet(); window.__drawingSet = window.__lastHtml; })()

steps.name: capture-trade-packs
steps.eval: (async () => { const { openTradePack } = await import('/src/ui/openTradePack.ts'); window.__packs = {}; for (const id of ['electrician','tiler','aircon']) { window.__lastHtml = null; await openTradePack(id); window.__packs[id] = window.__lastHtml; } })()

steps.name: assert-drawing-set-chain
steps.eval: (() => { const h = window.__drawingSet; for (const [label, re] of [['RCP sheet', /Reflected ceiling plan/i], ['FFL tag', /FFL/], ['waterproofing', /aterproofing/], ['trunking overlay', /trunking/i]]) { if (!re.test(h)) throw new Error('drawing set missing: ' + label); } return 'drawing-ok'; })()

steps.name: assert-pack-chain
steps.eval: (() => { const e = window.__packs.electrician; if (/No switching schematic/i.test(e)) throw new Error('electrician pack still excludes the switching schematic (round-1 P1)'); const t = window.__packs.tiler; if (!/FFL/.test(t)) throw new Error('tiler pack has no FFL row'); if (!/aterproof/.test(t)) throw new Error('tiler pack has no waterproofing row'); const a = window.__packs.aircon; if (!/trunking/i.test(a)) throw new Error('aircon pack has no trunking content'); return 'packs-ok'; })()

steps.name: scroll-rcp
steps.eval: (() => { const names=[...document.querySelectorAll('.tb-name')]; const el=names.find(n=>/Reflected ceiling/i.test(n.textContent||'')); const sheet=el&&el.closest('.sheet'); if (!sheet) throw new Error('RCP sheet not found'); sheet.scrollIntoView(); })()

steps.name: scroll-dim-plan
steps.eval: (() => { const names=[...document.querySelectorAll('.tb-name')]; const el=names.find(n=>/Dimensioned plan/i.test(n.textContent||'')); const sheet=el&&el.closest('.sheet'); if (sheet) sheet.scrollIntoView(); })()
